meta.purpose: follow-ups on the lines skipped as stale on 14 October 2026: Rover Owner2 to Ares Management Corp after the Blackstone sale, and the EIA August 2026 ref for Santa Fe Mainline

verifications.note: Blackstone's press release of 29 April 2026 says funds led by Ares bought the Blackstone Energy Transition Partners stake of 32.4 percent in Rover Pipeline.
A Pipeline and Gas Journal story from April 2026 says Ares Management acquired a 32.4 percent stake in Rover from Blackstone Energy Transition Partners.
A Marcellus Drilling News story from May 2026 says Blackstone sold its entire 32.4 percent stake in Rover to Ares Management.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Ares Management Corp replaces Blackstone as Owner2, as Baird asked on 14 October 2026. Funds led by the Ares Infrastructure Opportunities strategy bought the whole 32.4 percent stake that Blackstone funds held in Rover. Blackstone's press release and a Pipeline and Gas Journal story, both from 29 April 2026, report the sale as done. A Marcellus Drilling News story from May 2026 says Blackstone sold its entire stake. None of them gives a closing date. The stake stays at 32.44 percent. Energy Transfer and Traverse are not changed. The three stories likely trace to one announcement, so they are not independent.
